pro_course_detail.description:
WHO SHOULD TAKE THIS COURSE? 

Dedicated, desperate, highly motivated students who MUST quickly improve their English for work, school, or an exam.

😉 Before getting a package, please schedule a single lesson of any kind so that we can decide if this is the right course for you.

•	A document summarizing the scientific research into effective language learning methods. I will go over it with you so that you will know exactly what to do to improve as quickly as possible.

•	Speaking/listening practice (description, free talk, topic based, work based, etc..), pronunciation practice, vocabulary growth, corrections.

•	Spoken grammar practice (without the memorization of grammar rules or exercises). 

COMMITMENT REQUIRED

90-minutes/day, 5 days/week, for 10 weeks, including 1.5-2 hours of conversation classes a week with me. 

THREE MAJOR COMPONENTS

1. Conversation classes on Skype
You will have 2, 45 minute or 1-hour conversation classes a week with me. 

2. Daily homework outside of class
Three days a week you will do 90 minutes of homework. You’ll practice listening, reading, speaking, and sometimes a little writing. 

3. Homework report
At the beginning of each class, you will tell me about your homework to practice recalling what you learned, and to encourage you to continue practicing on your own. ;)

No Risk: Cancel at any time

If at some point you don’t feel like you can continue these lessons, you may cancel and receive a refund for classes not yet taken.

pro_course_detail.description:
Reading for pleasure is the fastest way to improve your grammar and vocabulary!

(😉 Before getting a package, please schedule a single lesson so we can see if we're a good fit.) 

I will evaluate your English level and help you select an interesting book or article to read together in class. :D

IMPROVE YOUR PRONUNCIATION: We will take turns reading out loud so you can listen to and practice correct English pronunciation. Pronunciation is extremely important!

INCREASE YOUR VOCABULARY RAPIDLY: I will explain the meaning of new vocabulary words, so we can read without long pauses to look up the words in a dictionary. You will learn new words much more quickly than by other methods because you are learning in the context of a story and because you will see the words repeated. Language research says you will learn new vocabulary 10 to 20 times faster by reading, than by using traditional methods.

IMPROVE YOUR GRAMMAR: The science of language learning tells us the best way to improve English grammar is to read extensively. As you do, your brain will unconsciously absorb grammar. This is much MORE FUN AND EFFECTIVE than studying grammar in textbooks.

GAIN CONVERSATIONAL CONFIDENCE: We will talk about what we read which can reduce the pressure of trying to figure out what to discuss. ;)

pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the Pronunciation & Accent Training ESL English program! As an experienced language instructor, I am dedicated to helping you develop clear and confident English pronunciation, and to refine your accent to effectively communicate in any English-speaking setting.
In this specialized course, we will focus on several key areas to enhance your pronunciation and accent:
Phonetics & Sounds: We will explore the different sounds present in the English language, paying particular attention to those that may not exist in your native language. Through interactive exercises and drills, you will learn to produce these sounds accurately.
Word Stress & Intonation: Understanding word stress and intonation patterns is essential for natural and expressive speech. You will master the rhythm and melody of English, making your speech more engaging and easy to understand.
Vowel & Consonant Sounds: We will dive deep into English vowel and consonant sounds, addressing common challenges and helping you articulate them with precision.
Reduced Speech & Linking: English speakers often link words together and use reduced speech in everyday conversation. You will learn these techniques to sound more like a native speaker and improve your listening comprehension.
Accents & Regional Variations: While achieving a neutral accent is the primary goal, we also embrace and appreciate various English accents and regional variations. You will gain exposure to different accents, helping you adapt to diverse English-speaking environments.
Remember, perfect pronunciation is not the goal. Our aim is to help you communicate clearly and confidently, embracing your unique voice while developing a solid foundation in English pronunciation!

pro_course_detail.title: Read an article & discuss it with me!
pro_course_detail.description:
Objective: To improve reading skills, pronunciation, and comprehension through reading and discussing news articles.

Website: https://newsforkids.net/ (for A2-B1 students), https://www.npr.org/ (for B1-C2 students) or https://commonlit.org/en

Introduction: Welcome to the "Read an Article" lesson! In this lesson, you will have the opportunity to practice your reading skills, expand your vocabulary, and improve your pronunciation. 

Step 1: Article Selection
For A2-B1 students, we will be using the website https://newsforkids.net/ which provides interesting and age-appropriate news articles. B1-C2 students will have access to https://newsela.com/, a platform that offers articles at various reading levels to suit your proficiency. Select an article that interests you and make sure it is appropriate for your language level.

Step 2: Reading and Note-Taking
During the lesson, you will read the chosen article aloud while I listen attentively. As you read, I will type comments on Skype or in a shared document. These notes will help me identify areas for improvement in your pronunciation and comprehension.

Step 3: Pronunciation Practice
After you finish reading the article, we will focus on pronunciation. We will work together to correct any mispronunciations and ensure that you pronounce words accurately. To aid in this process, I will use phonetic symbols (/ˈsɪmblz/) to explain the correct pronunciation.

→ I will also write corrections in chat while you speak, and I will make suggestions about pronunciation, word choice, and grammar. 

Choose to practice your English! (`･ω･´)9

pro_course_detail.title: Discuss a specific topic with my PowerPoints (improve your English with topic-based lessons!)
pro_course_detail.description:
This is something you can use with any language. It's best to focus on 1 topic with a tutor. It's important to really "exhaust" the topic. For example, if you talk about the weather, talk about everything about the weather. Prepare for the lesson by learning vocabulary related to the topic, and then you try to talk about it for the entire session. If you pick "weather," you would talk about the weather today, the weather tomorrow and yesterday, the weather on vacation, how it's normally in May or December, how it's normally in Europe, the weather where you live, etc., and by the end of the session, you'll be very good at this topic, and you'll be able to express yourself just like any other native speaker. 

You can use one of my PowerPoints below. They include warm-up questions, pictures, questions, dialogue for 2 people to read, vocabulary practice, reading, etc. 

For upper beginner (20+ PowerPoints available):

~ dialogues (beginner through advanced)
~ working through a comprehensive guide on American English (book can be bought by student if desired)
~ listening to videos (advanced)
~ listening to songs (elementary through advanced)

Students will learn about:

~ pronunciation of phrases in connected speech

I'm a native English speaker and speak Standard American English. There are different varieties of spoken English in the US, and if anything, I may speak a "Western" variety of American English since I have spent most of my life on the West Coast. This means I don't make any difference between "cot" and "caught", for example. I studied Clinical Phonetics in speech language pathology and know IPA (the International Phonetic Alphabet). I also may try to relate American English sounds to those in other languages I have studied (French, Japanese, Italian, Chinese, German). 

Although a one-hour lesson is offered, it's not necessarily recommended to take a one-hour pronunciation lesson as it will be fairly tiring. pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
One of the best ways to learn a language is through conversation.  We can talk about everyday life or any topics that interest you.  Don't know what to talk about? No problem! We can use conversation cards with random topics, or we can play fun games that promote conversation. 

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about.  The homework is always optional, but it helps you get the most out of our time together.

This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a structured plan that will take you to the next level? Then this class is for you! This course follows a logical sequence. First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.

pro_course_detail.title: TOEFL, IELTS, CAE, and Duolingo Test Prep
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help you achieve the best score possible on whichever English proficiency exam you are preparing for.  Using practice exams as a guide, we will pinpoint any weaknesses and fine-tune them.

Before the first class, please send me a message informing me which exam you will be taking and the exam date. This way, we can create a study plan that is specific to your needs. If your exam date is soon, we can get down to business by practicing the speaking portion of the exam, linking words, and exam tips.  If you have several weeks to prepare, we can cover all four portions of the exam. If you have several months to prepare, we can even follow a textbook.

pro_course_detail.description:

This class is for those who have already completed a written document and would like to have it checked by a professional with experience in business and academic writing. However, the rules of this lesson type are a bit different.

No "live" editing is done. We will not meet during the lesson. Please send your document (Word, PDF, Pages, etc.), and it will be edited, with corrections and suggestions marked using Review Mode. You will be able to see all edits and changes.

If you do not see your document type listed below, message me with your details (what type of writing), and I will see if it is possible after reviewing. 

*Document Types Accepted* 
Statement of Purpose (SOP)
Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
Business Plan / White Paper / Executive Summary / Internal Documents / In-house company stylizations. 
Academic papers (APA, MLA, LaTeX, CMOS, Harvard Style, etc.)
Developmental Editing (Manuscripts, e-book formatting for publication, such as InDesign, InCopy, Vellum, etc.)
Dissertation & Theses review (formatting to in-house style and citation checking). 

Remember: Editing classes are paid by word or project and are quoted after I have seen your material. I do not do live editing in these classes; you are paying for the document to be corrected and sent back. No meeting will take place.

If you believe you need to meet before, book a 30-minute class and message that we need to discuss your project before I can begin editing. This is likely for developmental editing (manuscript editing) but rarely necessary for academic corrections other than dissertations or theses.
